api_key.description: The mijn.host API key. Can also be set via the MIJNHOST_API_KEY environment variable.

block.description: Interact with mijn.host to manage DNS records for your domains.

id.description: Unique identifier for this DNS record, in the format domain/type/name/value.

name.description: DNS record name/hostname. Use the bare domain name for apex records (e.g. example.com), or a subdomain (e.g. www.example.com).

type.description: DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, etc.).

value.description: DNS record value (e.g. an IP address for A records, or the target for CNAME records).

block.description: Manages a single DNS record for a mijn.host domain. Changes to domain, type, name, or value will force a new resource. Only TTL can be updated in place.

domain.description: The domain name to manage DNS records for (e.g. example.com).

id.description: The domain name (used as the resource ID).

type.description: DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, etc.).

records.description: The complete set of DNS records for the domain. All existing records not listed here will be deleted.

block.description: Manages the complete set of DNS records for a mijn.host domain. On every apply the entire record set is replaced with exactly what is listed here — any record not listed, including records added outside of Terraform or created automatically by mijn.host, will be deleted. Use mijnhost_dns_record instead to manage individual records without affecting others.

domain.description: The domain name to look up (e.g. example.com).

id.description: The domain name (used as the data source ID).

renewal_date.description: The date on which the domain will be renewed (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: The current status of the domain (e.g. active, Cancelled).

block.description: Retrieves information about a mijn.host domain.
